_register: Formal vikanje (never ti) in sentences addressed to the reader, with the plural imperative in instructions (Kliknite, Skenirajte črtno kodo); buttons, menu entries and step titles use the short imperative as Slovenian software does (Shrani, Prekliči, Izposodi) or a noun (Izposoja, Vrnitve); no jokes, no exclamation marks.
_quotes: Slovenian low-high quotes „text“ (U+201E and U+201C, no space inside); nested quotes use »text« ; the arrow → stays. Dates are written 1. 11. 2026 (a space after each full stop), the decimal separator is a comma, and a space goes between a number and % or a unit (50 %, 70 mm).
_plural: Slovenian has four plural forms: one (1, 101, …), two (2, 102, …), few (3, 4, 103, …) and other (0, 5 and above, 11–19); the dual « two » is a real form (2 knjigi), so every counted message needs all four options.

copy.note: One physical copy with its own barcode, as in COBISS and Slovenian libraries; never « kopija » (a photocopy). Plural « izvodi », dual « izvoda ».

record.note: Bibliographic record (COBISS: « bibliografski zapis »); the short « zapis » is used in labels.

patron.note: Slovenian libraries say « uporabnik » (or « član » for a registered member, as in COBISS); « uporabnik » is chosen because it also fits teachers. Plural « uporabniki ».

card.note: Short form of « knjižnična izkaznica » / « članska izkaznica »; « izkaznica » alone where the context is clear.

loan.note: The action and the area (« Izposoja »); one loan as an item is also « izposoja ».

return.note: The action: « Vrnitev » on the menu, plural « Vrnitve »; verb « vrniti ».

renew.note: Extending the due date; verb « podaljšati ». COBISS also says « podaljšati izposojo ».

due date.note: Short and usual in Slovenian libraries.

overdue.note: A book past its due date; the noun is « zamuda ».

reminder.note: The printed slip asking for the return; plural « opomini ».

call number.note: The shelf mark on the spine (B 4 DEL, 590 ROS); « signatura » is the standard Slovenian library word.

spine band.note: The coloured band with pictogram and signatura on the spine; « hrbtni trak » is the equivalent short form.

label.note: An adhesive label with a barcode; « etiketa » is not used.

class.note: A school class (3. B); « oddelek » is the exact school term for a class group but « razred » is plain and understood.

group.note: Used for a group of teachers.

reading level.note: The school year a book is meant for; « bralna raven » is also used, one is kept everywhere.

classification.note: The sorting scheme (UDK, the Universal Decimal Classification, is used for non-fiction in Slovenia).

catalogue.note: Written « katalog »; « knjižnični katalog » where needed.

stocktaking.note: Checking the shelves against the catalogue; « revizija » (the formal library term for the check of the collection) is not used, « inventura » is the plain word.

wish list.note: Books a patron would like the library to have; « predlogi za nabavo » is the formal alternative, not used.

census.note: Registering the uporabniki with their photo; « popis s fotografijami ».

class upgrade.note: Moving every class up a year at the end of the school year; short form « prehod razredov ».

anonymise.note: Erase the personal data of a patron for good; noun « anonimizacija ».

backup.note: Here « kopija » is correct, it is a copy of data; plural « varnostne kopije ».

colour set.note: Written « barvna »; the palette of the interface.

scanner.note: The USB barcode reader that types like a keyboard; short form « bralnik ».

wizard.note: The first-start sequence of questions; « čarovnik za nastavitev » where fuller.

demo data.note: The invented school the program can fill itself with; « vzorčni podatki » is also usual, one is kept.

student.note: Primary-school pupil; plural « učenci ». Secondary students are « dijaki », so a neutral phrase « učenci in dijaki » may be used where both are meant; « učenec » is the default in the program.

teacher.note: Plural « učitelji »; feminine « učiteljica » only where the gender is known; « učitelj » is the plain form.

administration.note: The administration area of the program; « skrbništvo » and « administracija » are not used.

configuration.note: Plural; « konfiguracija » only in technical text.

return desk / circulation desk.note: The desk where loans and returns are handled; the area as a whole is « Izposoja ».
